result.summary: Identified minor visual issues including text truncation, an incomplete header icon, and a clipped category pill.

issues.description: Restaurant title 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated abruptly.
issues.suggestion: Add an ellipsis or allow two-line text wrapping.

issues.description: Top-right profile icon is a blank placeholder with an unaligned red dot.
issues.suggestion: Populate the container with a proper user avatar or notification icon.

issues.description: Category filter row ends with an unlabelled clipped pill on the edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure category labels fit or apply a smooth scroll fade effect.
